destinations.name: Brihadisvara Temple (The Big Temple)
destinations.description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site built by Raja Raja Chola I in 1010 CE, renowned for its 216-foot vimana, single-granite 80-tonne capstone, and grand Nandi.
destinations.descriptionTa: கி.பி 1010-ல் முதலாம் இராஜராஜ சோழனால் கட்டப்பட்ட யுனெஸ்கோ உலக பாரம்பரிய தளம். 216 அடி உயர விமானமும், 80 டன் எடை கொண்ட ஒரே கல் சிகரமும் இதன் சிறப்பம்சங்கள்.
destinations.historicalBackground: Commissioned in 1004 CE and completed in 1010 CE to celebrate the Chola Empire’s naval and cultural supremacy across South and Southeast Asia. The temple showcases pinnacle Dravidian engineering without binding mortar.
destinations.culturalImportance: Epicenter of classic Bharatanatyam dance traditions, ancient Tamil epigraphy, bronze casting, and Chola fresco paintings.
destinations.accessibilityNotes: Wheelchair access ramp available at outer courtyard; footwear stand provided outside inner sanctum.

nearbyAttractions.name: Thanjavur Maratha Palace & Saraswathi Mahal Library

transportation.nearestBusStand: Thanjavur Old Bus Stand (1.2 km) / New Bus Stand (4.5 km)
transportation.busConnectivity: Frequent city buses every 5 minutes from both bus stands.
transportation.trainConnectivity: Direct express trains from Chennai Egmore, Trichy, and Madurai.

destinations.name: Meenakshi Sundareswarar Temple
destinations.description: The soul of Tamil Nadu with 14 iconic multi-tiered gopurams, the thousand-pillar hall, sacred Golden Lotus pond, and divine aura.
destinations.descriptionTa: 14 கம்பீரமான கோபுரங்கள், ஆயிரங்கால் மண்டபம், பொற்றாமரைக்குளம் கொண்ட தமிழ்நாட்டின் ஆன்மிகத் தலைநகரம்.
destinations.historicalBackground: Mentioned in ancient Tamil Sangam literature (6th century BCE). Rebuilt by the Nayak rulers in the 16th-17th centuries with intricate stone sculptures and musical pillars.
destinations.culturalImportance: Dedicated to Goddess Meenakshi (Parvati) and Lord Sundareswarar (Shiva). Goddess Meenakshi is worshipped first, symbolizing matriarchal spiritual reverence.
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: October to March; April during the Chithirai Festival
destinations.accessibilityNotes: Battery-operated carts outside perimeter; strict dress code (traditional wear); electronics checked into locker.

transportation.nearestBusStand: Periyar Bus Stand (1.1 km) / Mattuthavani Integrated Bus Terminus (6.5 km)
transportation.busConnectivity: Constant city buses (Route 48, 77) connecting from all terminals.
transportation.trainConnectivity: Major Southern Railway junction with Superfast & Vande Bharat links.
transportation.taxiAvailability: Local auto rickshaws, taxi stands, and Ola/Uber services available 24/7.

destinations.name: Dhanushkodi Beach & Ghost Town
destinations.description: The tip of India where the Bay of Bengal meets the Indian Ocean. A poetic abandoned town preserved after the 1964 cyclone, with Ram Setu vantage points.
destinations.descriptionTa: வங்காள விரிகுடாவும் இந்தியப் பெருங்கடலும் சங்கமிக்கும் இந்தியாவின் விளிம்பு. 1964 புயலுக்குப் பின் உறைந்த அமைதி பூமி.
destinations.historicalBackground: Once a flourishing port city with rail connections to Sri Lanka (Boat Mail Express). Destroyed in the catastrophic 1964 Rameswaram cyclone, declared an uninhabitable ghost town.
destinations.culturalImportance: Legendary point where Lord Rama’s bow (Dhanush) marked the alignment for building the Ram Setu (Adam’s Bridge) towards Lanka.
destinations.weeklyHoliday: Open all days (Strict entry closes at 5:00 PM for safety)
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: November to February (Early morning or sunset hour)
destinations.accessibilityNotes: Well-paved national highway (NH 87) leads straight to Arichal Munai. Sandy walking paths near ruins.

nearbyAttractions.name: Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam National Memorial

transportation.busConnectivity: Government buses ply every 30 minutes from Rameswaram to Dhanushkodi.
transportation.trainConnectivity: Take train to Rameswaram over the historic Pamban Sea Bridge, then road.
transportation.taxiAvailability: Shared tourist jeeps and cabs available from Rameswaram temple.

destinations.name: Pichavaram Mangrove Forest
destinations.description: The world’s second-largest mangrove ecosystem with 4,400 canals and 1,100 hectares of water channels sheltered by evergreen trees.
destinations.descriptionTa: உலகின் இரண்டாவது மிகப்பெரிய அலையாத்தி காடுகள். 4,400 இயற்கைக் கால்வாய்களுடன் கூடிய சூழல் சொர்க்கம்.
destinations.historicalBackground: Naturally nurtured by the Vellar and Coleroon estuaries for over a millennium. Protected the inland delta during the 2004 tsunami with its dense root network.
destinations.culturalImportance: Critical refuge for 177 species of migratory birds including snipes, pelicans, and egrets. Traditional rowing community guardians.
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: November to February (Migratory bird watching season)
destinations.accessibilityNotes: Boarding jetty requires walking down steps; life jackets mandatory for all passengers.
localFoodSpecialties: Crab Masala & Prawn Fry (Local coastal seafood)

transportation.busConnectivity: Regular town buses and shared autos connect Chidambaram to Pichavaram eco-dock.
transportation.trainConnectivity: Mainline trains between Chennai and Tiruchirappalli halt at Chidambaram.
transportation.taxiAvailability: Private taxis readily hired from Chidambaram railway station.

emergencyContacts.hospital: Rajah Muthiah Medical College & Hospital, Annamalainagar (Ph: 04144-238249)

destinations.name: Nilgiri Mountain Railway & Ooty
destinations.description: A 1908 UNESCO World Heritage meter-gauge steam train climbing through lush tea estates, 16 tunnels, 250 bridges, and eucalyptus clouds to Queen of Hill Stations.
destinations.descriptionTa: 1908-ம் ஆண்டு யுனெஸ்கோ உலக பாரம்பரிய நீராவி மலை இரயில். மேகங்களைத் தொடும் தேயிலைத் தோட்டங்கள் வழியே மறக்க முடியாத பயணம்.
destinations.historicalBackground: Engineered by Swiss engineer Riggenbach and British engineers using the Abt rack and pinion system to conquer the steepest mountain grade in Asia (1 in 12.5 gradient).
destinations.culturalImportance: Celebrated symbol of hill heritage, Toda tribal community homelands, and colonial botanical architecture.
destinations.weeklyHoliday: Daily services (Subject to monsoon track clearance)
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: March to June (Summer) and September to November (Post-monsoon freshness)
destinations.estimatedVisitingDuration: Half day to full day experience
destinations.accessibilityNotes: Wheelchair assistance available on station platforms (Mettupalayam, Coonoor, Ooty).

nearbyAttractions.name: Doddabetta Peak (Highest point in Tamil Nadu)

transportation.nearestBusStand: Ooty Central Bus Stand (0.5 km) / Coonoor Bus Stand (19 km)
transportation.nearestRailwayStation: Udhagamandalam Railway Station (UAM) - in town center
transportation.busConnectivity: Direct buses every 15 mins to Coimbatore, Mysore, Bangalore, and Calicut.
transportation.trainConnectivity: Connected to Mettupalayam (MTP), which links to Chennai via Nilgiri Express.
transportation.taxiAvailability: Prepaid tourist cabs and shared jeeps available at Charring Cross.

destinations.name: Avalanche Lake & Sanctuary (Hidden Gem)
destinations.description: An untouched alpine-like valley surrounded by rolling green hills, rhododendrons, trout fishing streams, and secluded forest department safaris.
destinations.descriptionTa: சுற்றுலாப் பயணிகளின் கூட்ட நெரிசலற்ற அழகிய அமைதியான ஏரி. பூக்கள் பூத்துக் குலுங்கும் பசுமை பள்ளத்தாக்கு.
destinations.historicalBackground: Formed naturally after a colossal landslide in 1823 that reshaped the topography, creating this tranquil reservoir in the Nilgiri Biosphere reserve.
destinations.culturalImportance: Crucial watershed and pristine sanctuary for endangered Nilgiri Tahr, wild bison (Gaur), and rare montane flora.
destinations.weeklyHoliday: Open all days (Forest eco-safari vehicle mandatory)
destinations.accessibilityNotes: Private vehicles must park at Forest Checkpost; Forest department safari buses take visitors inside.

transportation.busConnectivity: Limited local buses (2 daily from Ooty); hired cabs recommended.
transportation.taxiAvailability: Taxis can be hired for half-day round trips from Ooty town center.

emergencyContacts.policeStation: Avalanche Forest Checkpost & Emerald Police Station (Ph: 0423-2595222)

destinations.name: Mahabalipuram Shore Temple & Pancha Rathas
destinations.description: 7th-century rock-cut monolithic wonders facing the Bay of Bengal, built by the Pallava kings Narasimhavarman II. Features Arjuna’s Penance bas-relief.
destinations.descriptionTa: 7-ம் நூற்றாண்டின் பல்லவர் கால பாறை குடைவரை சிற்பங்கள் மற்றும் கடற்கரைக் கோயில். யுனெஸ்கோ உலக பாரம்பரிய பெருமை.
destinations.historicalBackground: Ancient port of the Pallava dynasty where merchant ships sailed to Cambodia, Java, and Sri Lanka. The Shore Temple has withstood sea salt, storms, and the 2004 tsunami.
destinations.culturalImportance: Cradle of South Indian temple architecture transition from rock-cut caves to free-standing structural stone shrines.
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: November to February; December during Indian Dance Festival
destinations.accessibilityNotes: Paved stone pathways connect monuments; battery cars available for senior citizens.
localFoodSpecialties: Fresh grilled catch of the day

transportation.nearestRailwayStation: Chengalpattu Junction (29 km) / Chennai Central (55 km)
transportation.busConnectivity: Frequent ECR AC buses (588, 599) from Chennai CMBT and Thiruvanmiyur.
transportation.trainConnectivity: Chengalpattu Junction connects to Southern Railway lines.
transportation.taxiAvailability: ECR taxis, auto-rickshaws, and bicycle rentals available everywhere.

destinations.name: Mannavanur Eco Village & Lake (Hidden Spot)
destinations.description: A postcard-perfect farming hamlet 35 km from Kodaikanal with terraced cabbage fields, sheep research farms, serene lake coracle rides, and pine breezes.
destinations.descriptionTa: கொடைக்கானலிலிருந்து 35 கி.மீ தொலைவில் உள்ள இயற்கை எழில் கொஞ்சும் கிராமம். அமைதியான ஏரியும் பசுமைப் புல்வெளிகளும்.
destinations.historicalBackground: Traditional indigenous farming community that has preserved organic terraced agriculture and indigenous sheep rearing for over 200 years.
destinations.culturalImportance: Location of the Central Sheep & Wool Research Institute and high-altitude wetland ecosystem.
destinations.accessibilityNotes: Scenic country road; grass meadows involve gentle walking.

transportation.busConnectivity: Government buses depart Kodaikanal bus stand at 6:30 AM, 12:00 PM, and 4:00 PM.
transportation.trainConnectivity: Kodai Road on Madurai-Dindigul line, followed by scenic ghat road cab.
transportation.taxiAvailability: Day-hire cabs from Kodaikanal town charge approx ₹1800-₹2400 for return trip.

destinations.name: Vivekananda Rock Memorial & Thiruvalluvar Statue
destinations.nameTa: விவேகானந்தர் பாறை நினைவு மண்டபம் & திருவள்ளுவர் சிலை
destinations.description: The southernmost tip of the Indian subcontinent (Triveni Sangam), where Swami Vivekananda meditated and the 133-foot stone statue of Tamil poet Thiruvalluvar stands tall.
destinations.descriptionTa: முக்கடல் சங்கமிக்கும் இந்தியாவின் தென் முனை. 133 அடி திருவள்ளுவர் சிலையும் விவேகானந்தர் பாறையும் கம்பீரக் காட்சி.
destinations.historicalBackground: Built in 1970 to honor Swami Vivekananda’s enlightenment here in 1892. The Thiruvalluvar statue by Dr. V. Ganapati Sthapati weighs over 7,000 tonnes, symbolizing the 133 chapters of Thirukkural.
destinations.culturalImportance: Tri-sea confluence of Indian Ocean, Arabian Sea, and Bay of Bengal. Rare geography where both sunrise and sunset can be viewed from the exact same beach.
destinations.weeklyHoliday: Open all days (Ferry subject to sea conditions)
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: October to March (Chitra Pournami full moon in April is legendary)
destinations.accessibilityNotes: Government Poompuhar ferry services have assisted ramps; life jackets mandatory.
localFoodSpecialties: Nanjil Nadu Fish Curry & Red Rice
Banana Chips in Pure Coconut Oil

transportation.busConnectivity: Direct express buses to Chennai, Madurai, Trivandrum, and Bangalore.
transportation.trainConnectivity: Direct long-distance trains from Jammu Tawi, Dibrugarh, Mumbai, and Delhi.
transportation.taxiAvailability: Local auto stands and taxis line the beach road and railway exit.

destinations.name: Hogenakkal Waterfalls (Niagara of India)
destinations.description: The thundering Kaveri River cuts through ancient carbonatite rocks, creating mist that looks like smoke ("Hoge" = smoke, "Kal" = rock). Famous for coracle rides.
destinations.descriptionTa: காவிரி ஆற்றின் கம்பீரப் பிரவாகம். பரிசல் சவாரியும் மூலிகை எண்ணெய்க் குளியலும் புகழ்பெற்ற அனுபவம்.
destinations.historicalBackground: The carbonatite rock formations here are among the oldest geological structures in South Asia, dating back over 2 billion years.
destinations.culturalImportance: Famous for traditional herbal oil massages and freshly caught river fish fry prepared by local boatmen communities.
destinations.weeklyHoliday: Open all days (Coracle rides suspended during peak flood warning)
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: August to December (Good water volume after monsoon)
destinations.accessibilityNotes: Suspension bridge gives clear panoramic view; stairs lead to coracle boarding point.
localFoodSpecialties: Fresh river Kendai fish fry on banana leaf
Ragi Mudde (Finger Millet Ball) & Country Chicken Curry

transportation.nearestBusStand: Pennagaram Bus Stand (16 km) / Dharmapuri Central (46 km)
transportation.busConnectivity: Frequent TNSTC buses running every 20 minutes from Dharmapuri to Hogenakkal.
transportation.trainConnectivity: Trains to Dharmapuri on Bangalore-Salem route.
transportation.taxiAvailability: Private cabs easily hired from Dharmapuri railway station.

destinations.name: Chettinad Heritage Mansions & Athangudi
destinations.description: Palatial 19th-century mansions built by Nagarathar seafaring merchants with Burmese teak, Italian marble, Belgian crystal chandeliers, and handmade Athangudi tiles.
destinations.descriptionTa: பர்மா தேக்கு மரங்கள், இத்தாலிய பளிங்கு கற்கள், கைவினை ஆத்தங்குடி டைல்ஸ்களுடன் கட்டப்பட்ட செட்டிநாட்டு மாளிகைகள்.
destinations.historicalBackground: The Nagarathar trading community traded spices, gems, and textiles across Burma, Malaya, Ceylon, and Vietnam, channeling their global fortunes into building these self-sustaining mansions.
destinations.culturalImportance: Renowned globally for Chettinad culinary architecture, brass kitchenware craft, and traditional Kottan palm-leaf basketry.
destinations.accessibilityNotes: Most mansion ground courtyards are accessible on level flagstones.

transportation.nearestRailwayStation: Karaikudi Junction (KKDI) - 13 km / Chettinad Station (CNND) - 3 km
transportation.busConnectivity: Local town buses connect Karaikudi to Kanadukathan every 30 minutes.
transportation.trainConnectivity: Karaikudi connects via Pallavan Express and Rameswaram Express to Chennai.
transportation.taxiAvailability: Heritage homestays arrange autos, taxis, and heritage cycle tours.

destinations.name: Kolli Hills & Agaya Gangai Falls (Hidden Spot)
destinations.description: An unexplored mountain of medicine with 70 continuous hairpin bends, medicinal herbs, Arapaleeswarar temple, and the magnificent 300-foot Agaya Gangai waterfall.
destinations.descriptionTa: 70 கொண்டை ஊசி வளைவுகளுடன் கூடிய மூலிகை மலை. 300 அடி உயரத்திலிருந்து விழும் ஆகாய கங்கை நீர்வீழ்ச்சி.
destinations.historicalBackground: Ruled in the Sangam era by the legendary philanthropic king Valvil Ori, famous for his unmatched archery skill celebrated in Purananuru poetry.
destinations.culturalImportance: Revered as a Siddha medicine haven. The cool waters of Agaya Gangai are believed to wash through dense medicinal herbs in the Eastern Ghats.
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: September to February (Lush greenery and steady stream)
destinations.estimatedVisitingDuration: Half day (1000 steep stone steps descend to falls)
destinations.accessibilityNotes: Trek down to waterfall requires good physical stamina (1,000 steps); viewpoint at top is wheelchair-friendly.
localFoodSpecialties: Spicy Country Chicken Masala with Parotta

transportation.nearestBusStand: Semmedu Bus Stand (Kolli Hills top) / Namakkal Bus Stand (55 km)
transportation.busConnectivity: Direct TNSTC buses climb up from Namakkal and Salem throughout the day.
transportation.trainConnectivity: Namakkal and Salem connected on the Bangalore-Madurai railway grid.
transportation.taxiAvailability: Experienced mountain taxis available at the base town of Kalappanaickenpatti.

events.name: Pongal Harvest & Alanganallur Jallikattu
events.description: Tamil Nadu’s biggest cultural harvest festival featuring bull-taming valor, sweet sugarcane, kolam rangolis, and community worship.
events.ticketPrice: Free general admission (Gallery passes via district portal)
events.organizer: Government of Tamil Nadu Tourism & Animal Husbandry Dept

events.name: Madurai Chithirai Thiruvizha & Kallazhagar Entry
events.nameTa: மதுரை சித்திரைத் திருவிழா & கள்ளழகர் வைகை ஆற்றில் இறங்குதல்
events.description: A 12-day spectacle drawing over a million devotees to witness Meenakshi’s coronation and Lord Kallazhagar riding into the Vaigai river on a golden horse.
highlights: Golden horse river entry in emerald robes

events.name: Mamallapuram Indian Dance Festival
events.description: A month-long open-air festival where classical Bharatanatyam, Kathakali, Kuchipudi, and Odissi exponents perform against the floodlit 7th-century rock reliefs.
events.venue: Arjuna’s Penance Open Air Stage, Mahabalipuram
events.ticketPrice: Free admission with archaeological monument ticket
events.organizer: Department of Tourism, Government of Tamil Nadu
highlights: Performances backdropped by ancient rock sculptures
Folk dances including Karagattam and Kavadi Attam

events.name: Annual Ooty Flower Show & Fruit Festival
events.description: Over 200,000 potted plants and intricate botanical floral sculptures displayed across the 55-acre heritage Government Botanical Garden in Ooty.
highlights: Summer music concerts in the hills
